paragraphs: The XF R-Sport is a trim-level designation within the X260 generation (2015-present). Depending on the model year and market, it was offered with a variety of engines: the Ingenium 2.0L petrol (AJ200), the Ingenium 2.0L diesel (AJ200D), and - on earlier cars - the AJ126 3.0L supercharged V6. Because the engine varies from car to car, we always start with your registration to identify your exact unit before quoting.
about.boldParagraph: We continue to rebuild and replace Varies (AJ200, AJ200D, and other X260‑era units) engines for every XF R-Sport on the road.

cards.body: A 2.0-litre turbocharged petrol four-cylinder, fitted to many X260-era XFs. No independently confirmed widespread issue pattern for this petrol application; we inspect and replace timing chains, bearings and gaskets as standard during every rebuild.

A 2.0-litre turbo-diesel four-cylinder, also widely used across the X260 range. This engine is known for timing-chain wear; we replace timing chains, tensioners, injector seals and gaskets as standard on every diesel rebuild.

A 3.0-litre supercharged V6 petrol, offered on higher-spec X260 models until around 2019. No independent confirmed issue pattern for the XF R-Sport application; we service it to the same standard as our other Jaguar V6 rebuilds.

compatibility.intro: Because the R-Sport badge covers multiple engine types, fitting the wrong replacement or assuming parts are interchangeable risks expensive compatibility issues. Before we quote or supply anything, we confirm:

points.text: Your exact engine code (AJ200, AJ200D, or AJ126) via registration or VIN
Ancillary and ECU variations specific to your build

compatibility.footer: This is why we always start with your registration rather than a generic quote.
